name: autodrafts
description: Keeps what you typed in a message box and didn't send, when you leave the Session or clear the box, and puts it back when you ask. Sees everything you type in rush; keeps it only in its data folder. An example of the UI hooks: rush's own drafts do this already.

commands.name: restore
commands.description: put back the newest draft kept for this box (again for the one before)

commands.name: list
commands.description: say how many drafts are kept for this box

settings.title: Drafts kept per box
settings.description: The oldest go first once a Session (or the Prompt) has more.
